name: GWM / Haval
overview: The pioneer of Chinese vehicles in Australia, progressing from the 2009 Great Wall V240 ute to direct factory operations with the GWM Cannon, Haval H6, and Tank 300 off-roaders.
australian_history: Great Wall Motors (GWM) made Australian automotive history in 2009 when distributor Ateco Automotive launched the V240 and SA220, making Great Wall the very first Chinese brand sold in Australia. In 2016, GWM established a direct factory subsidiary in Melbourne and introduced the Haval SUV brand. In 2020, GWM rebranded under a unified identity, launching the rugged Cannon dual-cab ute, Haval Jolion compact SUV, Haval H6 midsize SUV (including H6 Hybrid and H6 GT coupe-SUV), and the Tank off-road sub-brand (Tank 300 and Tank 500), achieving top-10 monthly sales rankings.

models_catalog.name: Cannon / Haval H6 / Tank 300
models_catalog.overview: The backbone of GWM's Australian lineup: early pioneering V200/V240 utes, the best-selling Cannon dual-cab, high-tech Haval H6 hybrid, and heavy-duty Tank 300 4x4.

generations.summary: First Chinese vehicles in AU; 2.4L 4G69 Mitsubishi petrol (93kW) and 2.0L Turbo Diesel (105kW) with dual-range 4WD.
2.0L Turbo Diesel (120kW/400Nm), 8-speed ZF automatic, BorgWarner torque-on-demand 4WD, rear diff lock, and Cannon Alpha hybrid.
L.E.M.O.N. modular platform, 2.0L Turbo (150kW), 179kW H6 Dedicated Hybrid Transmission (DHT), and swoopy H6 GT.
Ladder-chassis off-roader, front and rear differential locks, 2.0L Turbo Petrol (162kW) and 258kW/615Nm Tank 300 Hybrid.

models_catalog.name: Haval Jolion
models_catalog.overview: GWM's popular family compact crossover, offering vast rear legroom, 1.5-litre turbo petrol, and punchy Jolion Hybrid.

generations.summary: 1.5L Turbo petrol (110kW/210Nm) with 7-speed DCT, and 139kW Jolion Hybrid with multi-mode transmission.
